subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which browser API slice should OpenClaw own next from this field report: model-advertised batch/selector support, stale/readiness/CAPTCHA state signals, CDP element inspection, or docs/skill-only guidance?
rationale: The remaining work changes model-facing action contracts and browser-state semantics, and several valid directions trade off power-user speed against deterministic ref-first guidance.

options.title: Scope state signals first
options.body: Define a narrow stale-ref/readiness/CAPTCHA response contract, then add docs, tests, and live browser proof for that slice.

options.title: Finish advertised batch/selector first
options.body: Align the Browser tool schema and docs with existing runtime batch/selector behavior before adding new state signals.

options.title: Split and close the umbrella later
options.body: Create or nominate narrower issues for each remaining API area, then close this umbrella once routing is explicit.

recommendation.title: Scope state signals first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow stale-ref/readiness/CAPTCHA response contract, then add docs, tests, and live browser proof for that slice.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal across the browser plugin boundary and VISION-level product direction.
